name: James Macy
current_role: Director, Office of Workers’ Compensation Programs
summary: James Macy directs the Office of Workers’ Compensation Programs, which runs federal workers’ compensation and black-lung and energy-worker benefits, and is quoted as director in its May 2026 announcements. He was earlier principal deputy administrator of the Wage and Hour Division and its acting administrator from September 2025 until Andrew Rogers took over.
